Applicant :- Aakash

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Pawan Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in case crime No. 246 of 2022, under Sections 376, 366, 506 IPC, police station Nautanwa, District Maharajganj, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
As per High School certificate age of victim is twenty years and thus, she is a major girl.

In her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr. P. C., victim has stated that on 14.11.2022 she has gone with the applicant to his house and due to that reason she was turned out from her home by her mother and that there has been physical relations between them, as the applicant has promised to marry with her but later on he refused to marry her.

Learned counsel Aakash vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41784611/
1 submitted that the allegations that physical relations were established on the pretext of marriage with her, are wholly false.

entities.text: Aakash vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Victim has not sustained any injury.
There are contradictions in the statements of the victim.

Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 01.12.2022, having no criminal history and that in case, applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant has established physical relations with the victim on the pretext of marriage.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Aakash involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 16.1.2024 / HR  Aakash vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41784611/
